configurationFields.label: Database Name
configurationFields.description: Optionally sets the initial database to connect to when the client run in GSCS is started. The database must exist on the server. Alternatively send the command 'use <database name>' in the GSCS console to switch to a specific database

configurationFields.label: Admin Connection Interface IP Address
configurationFields.description: Sets the IP address for the [admin connection interface](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/administrative-connection-interface.html). Must be a single IPv4 address, IPv6 address, host name, or network namespace identifier. Cannot be a wildcard address. Setting a valid address enables the admin connection interface on the server

configurationFields.label: Server Options File Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies [options file settings](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/option-files.html) to include in 'my.cnf' for the MySQL server that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line, including the option group heading. Additional information on [server variables](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/server-system-variables.html)

configurationFields.label: Additional Client Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Specifies [additional command line options](https://mysql.com/kb/en/mysql-options/) for the MySQL client run by GSCS (a super user called 'GSCS' on Linux and 'root' on Windows) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: MySQL Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets the MySQL release stream from which to install the latest version, unless a specific version is specified under MySQL Version. WARNING: SWITCHING BETWEEN RELEASE STREAMS OR DOWNGRADING VERSIONS MAY CORRUPT DATA! Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: MySQL Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [MySQL version](https://downloads.mysql.com/archives/community/) to install. Empty = latest version for the release stream specified under MySQL Release Stream. WARNING: SWITCHING BETWEEN RELEASE STREAMS OR DOWNGRADING VERSIONS MAY CORRUPT DATA! Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: Download MySQL
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $MySQLRelease='{SERVERVERSION}'; $MySQLVersion='{CUSTOMSERVERVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path 'mysql'; if (Test-Path 'bin/mysqld.exe') { $match = & bin/mysqld.exe -V | Select-String -Pattern 'Ver (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)'; $InstalledVersion = $match.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MySQLVersion) ) { $MySQLVersion = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/releases/$MySQLRelease\").result.latest.name }; if ( $MySQLVersion -notmatch '^(8|9)\.\d+\.\d+$' ) { Write-Output 'Invalid MySQL version format specified'; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $MySQLVersion ) { Write-Output \"MySQL v$MySQLVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { $splitVersion = $MySQLVersion -split '\.'; $MySQLMinorVersion = \"$($splitVersion[0]).$($splitVersion[1])\"; if ( Test-Path mysql.zip ) { Remove-Item mysql.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://cdn.mysql.com/Downloads/MySQL-$MySQLMinorVersion/mysql-$MySQLVersion-winx64.zip -OutFile mysql.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the MySQL CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"mysql.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path mysql.zip ) { Remove-Item mysql.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"mysql-*\") { if ( Test-Path 'lib/plugin' ) { Move-Item 'lib/plugin' 'plugin-bak' -Force *> $null }; Remove-Item * -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; New-Item 'lib' -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; Move-Item 'plugin-bak' 'lib/plugin' -Force *> $null; $source = Get-ChildItem -Directory -Filter 'mysql-*' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($source) { robocopy $source.FullName 'mysql' /E /MOVE /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -gt 7) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Write-Output \"MySQL v$MySQLVersion downloaded\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Initialize MySQL
deploymentSteps.arguments:
-c "cd . && { [[ -f "{SERVER_DIR}/data/mysql.ibd" ]] || { bin/mysqld --initialize-insecure --basedir="{SERVER_DIR}/" --datadir="{SERVER_DIR}/data" >/dev/null && echo -e "
Default database tables created
Super-users GSCS@localhost and root@localhost created with unix socket authentication
Use GSCS's console to manage the server via the GSCS@localhost user
"; }; }"

deploymentSteps.name: Initialize MySQL
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mysql'; if (Test-Path '{SERVER_DIR}/data/mysql.ibd') { exit 0 } else { & bin/mysqld.exe --initialize-insecure --basedir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/" --datadir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/data\" 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"`nDefault database tables created`nSuper-user root@localhost created with secure password authentication`nUse GSCS's console to manage the server via the root@localhost user`n\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Run MySQL Server
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mysql'; $env:MYSQL_PWD = \"{ROOTPASSWORD}\"; & bin/mysqladmin.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root --get-server-public-key ping *> $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { $AdminAddress = \"{ADMIN_ADDRESS}\"; if (![string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($AdminAddress)) { $AdminSetting = \"--admin-address=$AdminAddress \" } else { $AdminSetting = '' }; & bin/mysqld.exe --defaults-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/my.cnf\" --port={GAME_PORT} --mysqlx-port={SERVER_X_PORT} --admin-port={ADMIN_PORT} --basedir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/" --datadir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/data\" --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --bind-address={GAME_BIND} --mysqlx-bind-address={GAME_BIND} $AdminSetting--general-log-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/log/mysql.log\" --wait-timeout=28800 --named-pipe --console --upgrade=FORCE }"

deploymentSteps.name: Set Up MySQL
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && timeout=60; while ((timeout--)); do bin/mysqladmin --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock\" ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; done; ((timeout<0)) && { echo \"MySQL server failed to start. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; if bin/mysqladmin --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock\" --user=root --password=\"\" ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then bin/mysql --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock\" --user=root --password=\"\" -e \"FLUSH PRIVILEGES; ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH auth_socket; CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'GSCS'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH auth_socket; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'GSCS'@'localhost' WITH GRANT OPTION; FLUSH PRIVILEGES\"; fi; bin/mysql --protocol=socket --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock\" --user=GSCS -e \"FLUSH PRIVILEGES; DELETE FROM mysql.user WHERE User=''; DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS test; DELETE FROM mysql.db WHERE Db='test' OR Db='test\\_%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES\""

deploymentSteps.name: Set Up MySQL
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mysql'; for ($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { $env:MYSQL_PWD = \"{ROOTPASSWORD}\"; & bin/mysqladmin.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root --get-server-public-key ping *> $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Remove-Item Env:MYSQL_PWD; & bin/mysqladmin.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root --password=\"\" ping *> $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & bin/mysql.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root --password=\"\" -e \"ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '{ROOTPASSWORD}';\"; break } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if ($i -eq 60) { Write-Output \"MySQL server failed to start. Aborting\"; exit 1 } else { Write-Output \"*** NOTE: Any log messages immediately above or below relating to access being denied for the root user can be ignored. ***\"; $env:MYSQL_PWD = \"{ROOTPASSWORD}\"; & bin/mysql.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root --get-server-public-key -e \"FLUSH PRIVILEGES; DELETE FROM mysql.user WHERE User=''; DELETE FROM mysql.user WHERE User='root' AND Host NOT IN ('localhost'); DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS test; DELETE FROM mysql.db WHERE Db='test' OR Db='test\\_%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES\" }"
